marketMood: Week-ahead setup: OPEC+ output hike, Getty-Shutterstock collapse, and SpaceX Nasdaq-100 entry dominate a thin summer tape while traders await July 15 China GDP and July 28-29 FOMC.

upcomingEvents.event: SpaceX (SPCX) joins Nasdaq-100 — QQQ rebalancing effective at open
SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR (SKHY) listing — record ~$29B offering
China Q2 GDP + June retail sales & industrial production
US Section 122 tariffs (10%) expiration deadline — Congress must act

topStories.headline: OPEC+ Approves 188K bpd Output Increase for August as Middle East Tensions Ease
topStories.summary: Seven core OPEC+ members — led by Saudi Arabia and Russia — voted on July 5 to raise collective quotas by 188,000 barrels per day from August, continuing a gradual production restoration as the US-Iran peace MOU nears finalisation and Strait of Hormuz shipping recovers.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ Oil — WTI near $68–69/bbl; ↑ Asia energy-import economies; ↓ XLE, CVX on margin compression; Goldman Sachs year-end Brent target $80

topStories.headline: Getty Images Terminates $3.7B Shutterstock Merger After UK Regulator Demands Editorial Divestiture
topStories.summary: Getty's board unanimously voted on July 6 to terminate the Agreement and Plan of Merger after the UK Competition and Markets Authority demanded Shutterstock divest its entire editorial business — a condition both companies deemed commercially unacceptable.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ SSTK — merger premium fully collapses; ↓ GETY — loses strategic combination rationale; 10.500% senior secured notes trigger mandatory redemption; both stocks face standalone re-rating

topStories.headline: SpaceX (SPCX) Enters Nasdaq-100 Monday; $4.3B Forced Index Buy Due After Sunday Close
topStories.summary: SpaceX's fast-track Nasdaq-100 inclusion is effective before market open on July 7, requiring index-tracking funds — including the $800B+ QQQ — to purchase approximately $4.3 billion in SPCX; the stock has run from its $135 IPO price (June 12) to ~$171.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ SPCX — mechanical demand spike at open Monday; watch crowding and reversal risk mid-week; ↑ QQQ on added AI-infrastructure exposure

topStories.headline: June Payrolls Miss Deepens Rate-Cut Case; Fed's July Hike Now Off the Table
topStories.summary: June added just 57,000 nonfarm jobs — well below the ~115K consensus — with April/May revised down a combined 74,000; unemployment held at 4.2% and Fed Chair Warsh signalled no urgency to raise rates, dropping forward guidance in favour of pure data dependence.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ Rate-hike odds (July hike near zero); ↑ TLT on lower-for-longer bets; ↓ DXY on weaker dollar; 10Y yield fell to ~4.46%; next catalyst is July 28–29 FOMC

topStories.headline: USD/JPY Hits 161 as Japan Finance Minister Warns of FX Intervention; BOJ at 31-Year Rate High
topStories.summary: USD/JPY rose to 161.27 on Friday as Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama warned authorities stand ready to intervene; the Bank of Japan raised rates to 1% in June — the highest since 1995 — and board members have flagged a neutral rate target near 2%.
topStories.marketImpact: watch — JPY intervention risk elevated during thin summer liquidity; ↑ yen-hedged Japan equity plays; ↓ carry trades funded in JPY; ↑ 8306.T, 8316.T (banks benefit from rate normalisation)

topStories.headline: Nikkei Rebounds 1.47% to 69,744 on Payroll Miss; Japan AI Semis Stabilise After Selloff
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 recovered to close +1.47% at 69,744 on Friday, lifted by the weak US jobs report easing Fed hawkishness; financials (MUFG +1.9%, Mizuho +2.4%) and Toyota (+3.6%) led while semiconductor stocks partially stabilised after a bruising week.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ Japan financials (8306.T) and autos (7203.T); sector rotation from AI semis to value names continuing; Nikkei holding 31-year highs as structural bullish backdrop

topStories.headline: July 24 US Tariff Expiry Looms; Chinese Exporters Rush Shipments in Final Stretch
topStories.summary: Chinese exporters are accelerating shipments to the US ahead of the Section 122 tariff (10%) expiry on July 24, helping drive a ~15% YoY export surge in H1 2026; June trade data and China Q2 GDP arrive July 15 and are expected to confirm robust top-line growth.
topStories.marketImpact: watch — FXI cautiously supported near-term; key risk is Congressional renewal/reinstatement of tariffs post-July 24; Q2 GDP beat would support 0700.HK, 9988.HK

topStories.headline: South Korea KOSPI Hits Record Highs as Semiconductor Supercycle Drives 300% Earnings Growth Forecast
topStories.summary: South Korea's total market cap has soared 86% YTD to $5 trillion, overtaking India as the world's 6th largest equity market; the KOSPI is benefiting from a memory-chip supercycle driven by AI-compute demand, with 2026 earnings growth forecast at 300% — the strongest in Asia since the 1999 recovery.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ 000660.KS (SK Hynix), 005930.KS (Samsung) — supercycle driven by HBM and AI compute demand; SKHY Nasdaq ADR listing July 10 adds $29B in potential demand

topStories.headline: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $63K During US Holiday Weekend on Softening Inflation Signals
topStories.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,000 during thin July 4 holiday weekend trading, reversing a late-June slide to a 21-month low near $60,000; the move was supported by Fed Chair Warsh's comments on easing inflation expectations and aggressive whale accumulation of 270,000+ BTC.
topStories.marketImpact: watch — BTC still down ~30% YTD from $93K peak; US BTC ETFs recorded $4.5B in outflows in June; $65K is key resistance; hold above $60K for near-term sentiment stabilisation

companiesToWatch.name: SpaceX
companiesToWatch.reason: Nasdaq-100 index inclusion effective Monday July 7 triggers ~$4.3B in forced buying by QQQ and other index funds — mechanical demand spike expected at open with reversal risk into mid-week.

companiesToWatch.name: SK Hynix
companiesToWatch.reason: Nasdaq ADR (SKHY) targets July 10 listing at ~$29B — would surpass Alibaba as the largest ADR in US history; memory supercycle fundamentals remain strong with AI-compute HBM demand surging.

companiesToWatch.name: Getty Images
companiesToWatch.reason: Merger termination on July 6 leaves Getty standalone; mandatory note redemption and strategic vacuum require a new capital plan — stock faces material re-rating downward.

companiesToWatch.name: Shutterstock
companiesToWatch.reason: Merger premium fully collapses after UK CMA forced Getty's hand; standalone AI-imagery thesis needs rebuilding with no near-term catalyst.

companiesToWatch.name: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group
companiesToWatch.reason: BOJ at 1% and signalling path to 2% neutral rate — Japan's largest bank is a direct beneficiary of rate normalisation and outperformed last session (+1.9%) while the Nikkei rose on softer US rates.

companiesToWatch.name: Chevron
companiesToWatch.reason: OPEC+ approved another 188K bpd output hike for August; with WTI near $68-69, Chevron's Q3 earnings will face oil price headwinds and management's guidance on Hormuz recovery timing is key.
